title: Clipped evergreens read as solid, dense shapes
items: The four clipped columns on the Pullman palm house's terrace at 1729 Prairie are now dense dark spires, full almost to the top and drawn in to a blunt point, as Taylor's photographs show them.
Every clipped arborvitae, ball and standard in the 1904 front yards now has a solid body under its leaves, so you no longer see the wall or the stem through it, from near or far.
